Contributing to tflplanner

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for taking the time to contribute! Issues and pull requests are welcome at https://github.com/ichirio/tflplanner.

By participating in this project you agree to abide by its Code of Conduct.

How to contribute

  1. Open or comment on an issue to report a bug or propose a change (the issue forms guide you: Bug report / Feature request).
  2. For anything non-trivial, agree the approach on the issue first.
  3. Fork the repository, update your fork’s main from upstream, create a topic branch, make the change with its tests, and open a pull request against main. The next branch, the automerge label and merge-after: lines are the maintainers’ own workflow; a maintainer adds any label that is needed. The steps for updating the fork and rebasing a topic branch are in Git work for a contributor in AGENTS.md.
  4. Address review feedback; once CI is green and a maintainer approves, it is merged.

Before you open a pull request

  • devtools::test() passes and devtools::check() shows no errors or warnings.

  • lintr::lint_package() reports nothing (the configuration is .lintr).

  • R source files are ASCII: write non-ASCII text as \uXXXX escapes. The app’s Japanese strings live in inst/i18n/strings/<file>.csv (the R file that shows them; common.csv for several).

  • Record the change in the PR description. A PR never edits NEWS.md, CHANGELOG.md or Version:, and there is no separate memo file. Fill the template’s User-visible change (for NEWS) field without being asked: one or two bullets in NEWS style (what a user can now do, or what is fixed, named by its function or argument), or “none” for an internal change; then “Breaking: no”, or “Breaking: yes” with the migration. The maintainers write NEWS.md from the merged PRs at release. For example:

    ## User-visible change (for NEWS)

- The AI tab's docs field adds a file at once: on Browse, on Enter, or on
  leaving the field.

Breaking: no

    The maintainers bump the version when they tag or release.

tflplanner builds on rtfreporter; a change the table layout needs belongs there.
